scope: Research-only primary documentation/source plus DefiLlama; no repository code, tests, services, signing or strategy implementation changed.
tvl_warning: Protocol-wide combined TVL/ranks from browsed DefiLlama snapshots, not amounts using a specific passive strategy. Browser cache snapshots differ. TVL is scale evidence, not safety, profitability or exact current live-chain TVL.

tvl.safe_scale_statement: Approximately $2m combined protocol TVL in the retrieved snapshots; no exact synchronous live TVL verified.

versions.name: Classic v1 / archived two-position model
versions.status: Explicit Charm_Old; current legacy-withdrawal page says v1 holdings are HODL, not active LP. Do not use current aggregate TVL to imply this exact legacy strategy remains deployed/active.
versions.behavior: PassiveStrategy.rebalance97-115 calls Vault.rebalance with swapAmount0. It sets base around rounded current tick and provides bid/ask candidates; period, minimum tick movement, spot/TWAP agreement, keeper and extreme-tick constraints gate execution.
versions.vault_behavior: AlphaVault.rebalance253-308 closes both existing legs, optionally swaps only when swapAmount is nonzero, deploys maximum base, then one leftover bid or ask leg. Thus this passive caller is swap-free; the generic old vault capability is not inherently swap-free.

versions.name: Alpha Pro / v2 source and current three-position docs
sequence: Close and collect full, base and limit positions.
Calculate current rounded tick and new base/bid/ask boundaries.
Allocate optional fullRangeWeight, then maximum two-asset base.
Allocate remaining inventory into exactly one bid or ask.
Update lastTimestamp/lastTick only after the completed call.
versions.no_immediate_swap: No pool.swap call in this rebalance body. Callback support/imports do not imply a rebalance swap.
versions.controls: On-chain period/minTickMove/spot-TWAP/extreme-tick checks. Nonzero delegate restricts caller to manager/delegate; zero delegate allows any caller passing the checks. Parameters are manager-controlled.
versions.zero_full_range: Initial fullRangeWeight can be0, so the three-slot model can have only base+limit funded.
versions.all_one_asset_inference: With only one asset and no usable opposing dust, an in-range base mints0; the corresponding one-sided bid/ask can receive inventory. Active two-sided liquidity is not recreated automatically.
versions.rearm: Every rebalance consolidates old legs before creating the new bounded set, rather than accumulating another limit forever.

whitepaper.finding: Passive inventory conversion waits for market trades through the limit range. Continued price movement away can keep allocation increasingly one-sided; mean reversion is a strategy assumption, not guaranteed rebalancing completion. Marketing claims of avoiding MEV should not become an LP-wide immunity claim.

parameter_docs.finding: Base/limit widths, minimum period, minTickMove, full-range weight and TWAP controls are separate. Text saying greater TWAP deviation improves security is internally dubious: a larger allowed spot-average disagreement is normally a looser gate. Follow actual comparisons, not that sentence.

rebalancing_docs.finding: Positions are withdrawn and all holdings redeposited on rebalance. New deposits can sit idle until that action in this model; that behavior should not be copied into PoPL, which requires confirmed immediate entrant LP deployment.

protocols.name: Gamma

tvl.scope: Whole Gamma, not classic base/limit only.

current_strategy_docs.finding: Classic dual base/limit strategies remain documented, while v4 multiposition strategies support up to20positions. Different families must not be conflated.

dual_strategy_docs.finding: Dynamic ranges use price-percentage triggers and recenter at rebalance; allocation may depart50/50. Narrow-range fees may not compensate prolonged volatility/divergence losses. Pegged strategies can go out of range and earn no fees.

inspected_implementation.version: Source identifies Hypervisor v1.3 / Solidity0.7.6; not authenticated to every live Gamma vault.
inspected_implementation.sequence: Owner supplies base/limit ticks and amount minima. Core collects fees, burns both old legs fully, deploys maximum base then residual limit. No swap appears in this file; zero-liquidity mint is skipped. Both legs plus idle comprise NAV.
inspected_implementation.bounded_cycle: This rebalance replaces the two tracked legs; it does not accumulate arbitrary extra one-sided legs. Separate owner add/pull methods mean this statement is scoped to the classic rebalance path.
inspected_implementation.all_one_asset_inference: For a genuine in-range base and one-asset-only inventory, base can have zero liquidity and the configured one-sided limit can receive the asset. Core accepts caller-selected ranges; it does not itself prove the limit is passive/one-sided.
inspected_implementation.authority_and_quality: onlyOwner and provided minimum burn/mint amounts are present. This core does not itself contain a universal TWAP/cooldown check for rebalance; actual strategy/owner infrastructure must be reviewed separately.

security_docs.finding: FAQ specifically discusses proxy TWAP protection for deposits and single-sided-deposit risks. It is not proof every rebalance is TWAP-gated or immune to MEV. Published self-description is not a live deployment audit.

protocols.unknowns: Current proprietary off-chain exact rearming policy, per-vault production guards and all-version source/deployment mapping were not independently established.

protocols.name: Arrakis

tvl.scope: Combined Arrakis, not a single no-swap module/strategy.

legacy_v2_docs.finding: General manager framework for selected removals, optional whitelist-router swaps and selected additions. Multiple ranges/fee tiers; manager is explicitly semi-trusted unless another contract enforces strategy. No universal main+limit or always-no-swap policy.

legacy_v2_source.behavior: Each requested burn can remove some or all of a range; swap happens only when amountIn>0 through admitted routers and checked token deltas; requested mints may preserve or add ranges. Manager may perform a no-swap update, but closing/consolidating all legs and fixed two-position bounds are not inherent requirements.
legacy_v2_source.one_asset_limit: The framework can deploy a one-sided range selected by its strategy; no fixed recovery from all-one-asset inventory follows from the general core.

current_strategy_docs.finding: Bootstrap combines full-range and several bootstrapping ranges until near50/50, then stops. Flagship reacts to price/inventory/volatility; tailored strategies may swap through third-party aggregators. Search index accessible; direct fetch502, so exact deployed execution/rearm remains unverified.

current_manager_controls.finding: Owner configures executor, oracle, maxDeviation, minimum cooldown and maxSlippagePIPS. These constrain authorized management; do not transplant Arrakis timelocks/arbitrary executors into PoPL as requirements.

current_module_docs.finding: V3 module aggregates multiple positions and optional RFQ. HOT module separately exposes range adjustment and atomic external swap; that is not a two-position passive strategy.

protocols.unknowns: No verified production-wide automatic no-swap consolidation/rearm algorithm. Current module/protocol TVL is not evidence of such a strategy.

cross_protocol_inferences_for_popl: Strongest bounded precedent: atomic consolidation of both old legs, then max useful two-asset base and one residual single-sided leg; no market swap required for the rebalance itself.

This is a different architecture from retaining an untouched old main LP and repeatedly adding excess-only positions. Excess is defined relative to the selected new base after balances are available, not an independently withdrawable portion of AMM inventory.

Exactly two physical slots can prevent position proliferation, but NAV, harvest/rewards, conversions, contributions, compound, move/park/exit and canonical handoff must all sum both legs and classified idle.

A passive LP limit is reversible while liquidity remains. Trades can convert it back on retracement; a source-marketing limit order is not an irreversible settled order unless completed liquidity is removed.

All-one-asset inventory creates a real liveness/economic tradeoff: without swap or external opposite asset, no in-range two-asset base can be funded. Waiting for reverse trade avoids immediate taker costs but can leave little/no active fee earning indefinitely.

No immediate market swap removes one direct sandwich/taker-impact surface; it does not stop toxic flow, manipulation of chosen ranges/valuation, arbitrage against stale prices, deposit dilution or trusted-operator abuse.
A fresh two-leg profile plus accounting/recovery review is required; changing only Python timing cannot safely supply missing on-chain custody/accounting capabilities.
Do not copy redeemable ERC20-vault principal withdrawal or deposit-idle-until-rebalance behavior; PoPL rights and actual marginal entrant LP are different requirements.
research_limits: Mutable main/master source URLs are observations, not exact deployment authentication or audit approval.
No code compilation/tests/on-chain transactions/provider qualification performed.
DefiLlama API reads unavailable in web tool; snapshots/ranks differ by cache/as-of date.
Primary links only relied upon; unrelated gamma-named websites and third-party marketing search results excluded.
No assumption of profitability, no direct-swap strategy immunity guarantee, no wholesale recommendation to copy protocol architecture.
